title: Workflow Management System for Small Business: 5 Automation Ideas

facts.fact: The article was published on August 26, 2022, by Carol Mentis.
Claromentis, the vendor, describes its BPA platform InfoCapture as able to turn any process into a workflow or e-form; this is the vendor's own claim.
facts.quote: Our BPA platform, InfoCapture, can transform any process into a slick workflow or e-form.

facts.fact: The page defines a workflow as a sequence of steps laying out the operations, resources, and personnel required to implement business processes.
facts.quote: A workflow is a sequence of steps laying out the operations, resources, and personnel required to implement various business processes.

facts.fact: The page states that workflow software typically includes a form design tool with templates and customisable workflows that do not require coding knowledge.
facts.quote: Workflow software will typically include a form design tool with templates that provide pre-designed fields and workflows

facts.fact: The page gives a three-step general procedure for designing small-business workflows: design the layout, apply relevant business rules, and configure and implement the workflow.
